subject: Hospitality
title: OYO's Ritesh Agarwal: Budget Hotels at Scale
description: A micro-lesson that makes OYO's Ritesh Agarwal: Budget Hotels at Scale usable.

hook.text: Ritesh Agarwal dropped out of school at 17 and built OYO—a company that standardizes budget hotels across India and beyond.

buildup.text: OYO partners with independent budget hotels: it provides branding, technology, and standards in exchange for a revenue share.

discovery.text: The insight: millions of budget travelers lack reliable options. OYO brings predictable quality to the unpredictable budget tier.

twist.text: OYO expanded to 800+ cities across 80 countries in a decade. But hyper-growth brought quality control problems and complaints.

climax.text: Agarwal proved that the biggest hospitality opportunity might not be luxury—it's making budget stays consistently acceptable.

punchline.text: 17-year-old dropout, 800 cities, budget hotel empire. Scale met standards.

quiz.question: What problem does OYO solve in the hospitality market?
options: Budget hotels lack consistent quality—OYO standardizes them
